bugs_found: compound_interest accepts negative principal and silently truncates years/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior for fractional inputs
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal/finite; float amounts can raise TypeError with Decimal balances, and NaN/Infinity can propagate or trap inconsistently
transfer is not atomic: after debiting account_from, a failure while crediting account_to or constructing Receipt can leave balances inconsistent
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively creating an invalid charge/refund state
fx_convert rejects missing and zero rates but accepts negative rates, producing negative converted amounts
finance inputs are not validated as finite Decimals; NaN/Infinity across functions can silently propagate or raise unexpected decimal exceptions
